I can only help with Lumen billing questions, so I can't write a CSV parsing script. For coding help, a general-purpose assistant or Python documentation (such as the `csv` module docs) would be a better fit.

If you have a billing question, I can help with plan pricing (Starter is $12/user/month, Pro is $24/user/month), monthly vs. annual billing, refunds, cancellations, or finding invoices in Settings > Billing. For disputes, double charges, tax exemption, discounts, or enterprise pricing, please contact billing@lumen.io.
